description: This file defines the Task class and related functions for managing tasks within a project management system, including validation, dependency management, status updates, and database interactions.

classes.name: CircularReferenceError
classes.description: Custom validation error for circular task dependencies.

classes.name: EndDateCannotBeGreaterThanProjectEndDateError
classes.description: Custom validation error for task end date exceeding project end date.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: Represents a task in the project management system, with methods for validation, dependency management, status updates, and database interactions.

methods.name: get_feed
methods.description: Returns a formatted string representing the task's status and subject.

methods.name: get_customer_details
methods.description: Fetches customer name associated with the task.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs comprehensive validation of task data, including dates, dependencies, and status.

methods.name: validate_dates
methods.description: Validates that start and end dates are logically consistent.

methods.name: validate_parent_expected_end_date
methods.description: Ensures task's expected end date does not exceed parent task's end date.

methods.name: validate_parent_project_dates
methods.description: Validates task dates against project end date.

methods.name: validate_status
methods.description: Ensures task status is consistent, especially for templates and dependencies.

methods.name: validate_progress
methods.description: Checks that progress percentage is within valid range.

methods.name: validate_dependencies_for_template_task
methods.description: Validates dependencies for template tasks.

methods.name: validate_parent_template_task
methods.description: Validates that parent task is a template.

methods.name: validate_depends_on_tasks
methods.description: Validates that dependent tasks are templates.

methods.name: validate_completed_on
methods.description: Ensures completed_on date is not in the future.

methods.name: update_depends_on
methods.description: Updates the list of dependent tasks.

methods.name: update_nsm_model
methods.description: Updates nested set model for task hierarchy.

methods.name: on_update
methods.description: Actions to perform when task is updated, including hierarchy and dependency updates.

methods.name: unassign_todo
methods.description: Clears assignments when task is completed or canceled.

methods.name: update_total_expense_claim
methods.description: Calculates total expense claims for the task.

methods.name: update_time_and_costing
methods.description: Updates task's time and cost details based on timesheets.

methods.name: update_project
methods.description: Updates associated project details.

methods.name: check_recursion
methods.description: Checks for circular dependencies among tasks.

methods.name: reschedule_dependent_tasks
methods.description: Reschedules tasks dependent on this task based on end date.

methods.name: has_webform_permission
methods.description: Checks if current user has permission to view web form for the task.

methods.name: populate_depends_on
methods.description: Populates parent task's depends_on list.

methods.name: on_trash
methods.description: Prevents deletion if child tasks exist.

methods.name: after_delete
methods.description: Actions after task deletion, such as updating project.

methods.name: update_status
methods.description: Automatically updates task status based on end date.
